Singular ‘they’ — in particular, when it’s used for a specific person, as in “Kirby is writing their research statement” — is probably the most visible and most controversial trans language phenomenon in the English-speaking world. This has made it a useful place to study language attitudes, gender etiquette, and the ways that both are changing. It is also interesting for purely syntactic reasons: the fact that it is grammatical for some speakers challenges some theories of agreement, and motivates a new approach to grammatical gender in English.
